identification.required_next_evidence: board label, PCB revision, LCD FPC/panel part, touch controller, and measured connector rails

official_schematic_facts.display: two-lane MIPI-DSI; official Waveshare BSP selects ST7701, 480x800 portrait, 500 Mbps lane rate, and MIPI PHY LDO3 at 2500 mV
official_schematic_facts.touch: GT911 capacitive touch; official Waveshare BSP selects I2C SDA GPIO7, SCL GPIO8, reset GPIO23, and no interrupt GPIO
official_schematic_facts.audio: ES8311 codec, ES7210 echo-cancellation input, and 8-ohm 2W speaker header; official BSP selects I2S MCLK GPIO13, BCLK GPIO12, LRCLK GPIO10, DOUT GPIO9, DIN GPIO11, and amplifier GPIO53
official_schematic_facts.storage: official BSP selects ESP32-P4 on-chip LDO channel 4 for socket power, then SD D0/D1/D2/D3 GPIO39/40/41/42, CMD GPIO44, and CLK GPIO43
official_schematic_facts.wifi_transport: ESP32-C6-MINI-1 over four-bit SDIO: P4 CLK GPIO18, CMD GPIO19, D0/D1/D2/D3 GPIO14/15/16/17, and C6 enable/reset from P4 GPIO54; P4 GPIO6 also connects to C6 GPIO2
official_schematic_facts.usb_uart: H1 Type-C through CH343P USB-UART; USB0_5V/VBUS is the programming/power connector path
official_schematic_facts.usb_otg: H2 Type-C routes USBD_N/USBD_P to ESP32-P4 GPIO24/GPIO25 and exposes VBUS on the connector
official_schematic_facts.interface_header: J3 pin 16 is ESP32-P4 GPIO28, J3 pin 18 is ESP32-P4 GPIO29, and J3 pin 24 is GND; the exact schematic does not show another board load on GPIO28/GPIO29

display.blocker: exact LCD controller, timing, reset/power/backlight behavior, and physical revision are not yet confirmed

touch.blocker: exact touch controller, address, reset, interrupt, and I2C mapping are not yet confirmed

audio.blocker: Waveshare codec/amplifier initialization and GPIO route are not the Elecrow factory contract

storage.scope: exact-unit Console OS mount with an OS-owned journaled game-save namespace, plus exclusive H2 USB-device MSC host transfer and hash-gated H1 UART content staging
storage.resources: on-chip LDO channel 4; SDMMC0 at 1 MHz in one-bit mode on GPIO43 CLK, GPIO44 CMD, and GPIO39 D0; native H2 USB device on GPIO24/GPIO25; H1 CH343 USB-UART
storage.write_scope: host WRITE(10) while TinyUSB exclusively owns the unmounted microSD; an OS-owned H1 upload to one fixed non-runnable staging name while the app exclusively owns the mounted FAT volume; OS-owned bounded game-save objects below /SAVES while the app exclusively owns the mounted FAT volume; or an explicitly confirmed on-device conservative FAT32 metadata repair while the card is unmounted. No formatting, cartridge-selected path, or host-selected raw device path. Content staging requires size, chunk CRC32, exact content SHA-256, fsync, atomic rename, and final full-file readback. Game saves require fixed validated IDs, a copied non-blocking request, optimistic sequence, SHA-256 validation, stage/journal/backup recovery, and synchronized metadata. FAT repair requires unambiguous source metadata and per-sector write readback.

game_save_store.authorization_basis: explicit operator request on 2026-08-27 for persistent offline LORD progress and later Mac-hub synchronization
game_save_store.limits: at most two 16 KiB copied payload slots per foreground cartridge; LORD uses one AUTO slot below 4 KiB
game_save_store.safety_controls: app-owned mounted FAT only; no cartridge path or FAT handle; P4SAVE2 HMAC-SHA256 over the validated game ID, slot ID, schema, sequence, payload digest, and payload; one device-local 256-bit key in the exact bounded NVS scope below; constant-time tag comparison; optimistic host sequence; exact per-slot NVS freshness anchor over sequence and object SHA-256; stage fsync and full-object validation; one bounded backup; atomic rename; recoverable one-operation journal; queued worker outside game callbacks; unavailable while H2 host owns or transitions storage; legacy P4SAVE1 accepted only while the exact game/slot NVS downgrade marker remains open, then permanently rejected after resealing

internal_nvs_scope.authorization_basis: same exact-unit persistent offline save request; Phase-A casual SD-edit resistance only

keys.legacy_v1: one fixed 1176-byte P4LMRK2 registry with at most 32 full SHA-256 game/slot identities plus downgrade-closed, freshness-anchor-expected, and migrated-baseline-required flags; a valid 1048-byte P4LMRK1 record migrates once
keys.h<14hex>: one 88-byte P4HWAT1 freshness record per anchored registry entry, keyed by a 56-bit digest prefix and containing the full 256-bit slot identity, highest accepted sequence, and exact object SHA-256

internal_nvs_scope.legacy_marker_domain: P4SAVE2-LEGACY-CLOSED followed by NUL-delimited validated game and slot IDs
internal_nvs_scope.legacy_marker_lifecycle: query before accepting any P4SAVE1; append after successful P4SAVE2 installation, authenticated P4SAVE2 verification, or verified empty slot; bind an authenticated slot to its highest sequence and exact object SHA-256 in the same NVS commit that marks the anchor expected; a migrated P4LMRK1 identity requires its existing authenticated object before establishing the first anchor; if anchored SD files are all absent, expose an empty save at the retained sequence floor so only N+1 can be installed; never erase or reopen; malformed/full/read/write/pairing failure withholds saving
internal_nvs_scope.storage_protection: plaintext NVS; device-local random key and monotonic per-slot software freshness anchor; blocks casual SD-file rollback but makes no claim against NVS rollback, firmware readout, or firmware modification

device_fat_repair.authorization_basis: explicit operator request on 2026-08-23 for on-device FAT repair
device_fat_repair.repair_scope: restore one valid primary/backup boot-sector copy; restore one structurally invalid FAT mirror from its structurally valid peer; rebuild FAT32 FSInfo free-space hints
device_fat_repair.refused_scope: formatting, directory mutation, deleting entries, guessing between two structurally plausible divergent FATs, lost-chain recovery, cross-link repair, FAT12, FAT16, exFAT, GPT-only discovery, and arbitrary raw writes
device_fat_repair.safety_controls: two-step local UI confirmation, exclusive unmounted media ownership, keep-power-on warning before work, structural bounds checks, and immediate full-sector readback after every write

h1_uart_upload.authorization_basis: explicit operator request on 2026-08-20 for the two already backed-up exact units

wifi_scan.scope: official-schematic-reviewed, source-pinned passive-scan build candidate only
wifi_scan.resources: ESP32-C6-MINI-1; SDIO1 CLK/CMD/D0/D1/D2/D3 on P4 GPIO18/19/14/15/16/17; active-high C6 enable/reset on P4 GPIO54
wifi_scan.software_evidence: ESP-IDF 5.5.3 build with esp_hosted 1.4.7 and esp_wifi_remote 0.14.5; passive asynchronous scan service; no network connection configuration
wifi_scan.blocker: the exact unit's C6 firmware identity/protocol compatibility and live passive-scan behavior have not been captured over retained UART

usb_host.scope: official-schematic review plus operator-attested externally powered H2 experiment; no board VBUS-source authorization
usb_host.blocker: CC1/CC2 are 5.1 kOhm pulldowns; VBUS presence is not proof of a protected host-source path
usb_host.experimental_result: P4 HS host enumerated the powered external hub without firmware VBUS sourcing; its low-speed downstream controller was rejected because the pinned USB stack lacks the required high-speed-hub transaction-translator path

multiplayer_uart.authorization_basis: explicit operator confirmation on 2026-08-23 of the exact J3-16/J3-18/J3-24 crossover contract for both already identified Waveshare units
multiplayer_uart.scope: direct 3.3 V UART1 multiplayer on GPIO28/GPIO29 exposed at J3, with H1 UART0 relay fallback retained
multiplayer_uart.resources: UART1; TX GPIO28/J3-16; RX GPIO29/J3-18; common ground J3-24; 115200 baud 8-N-1
multiplayer_uart.electrical_contract: cross TX to peer RX in both directions and connect ground only; never connect 3V3 or 5V between consoles; 100-220 ohm series resistance per TX is recommended for first acceptance
multiplayer_uart.source: official commit-pinned Waveshare schematic plus ESP32-P4 GPIO capability and strapping review
multiplayer_uart.required_acceptance: retained H1 logs from both units showing direct route lock, lobby/start synchronization, sustained bidirectional Doom input, and clean fallback to H1 relay with the direct cable absent

multiplayer_ble.authorization_basis: explicit operator request on 2026-08-23 to flash and test BLE gaming on the two already backed-up exact Waveshare units
multiplayer_ble.scope: one-peer BLE GATT multiplayer transport selected explicitly from the local Doom lobby; UART remains the default transport
multiplayer_ble.resources: ESP32-C6-MINI-1 over four-bit SDIO on P4 GPIO18/19/14/15/16/17 with active-high C6 enable/reset on GPIO54; NimBLE host on ESP32-P4 over ESP-Hosted VHCI
multiplayer_ble.software_contract: ESP-IDF 5.5.3, esp_hosted 1.4.7, esp_wifi_remote 0.14.5; bounded framed notifications/writes, one connection, authenticated Secure Connections, lazy radio startup, immediate neutral/disconnected state on loss
multiplayer_ble.required_acceptance: retained H1 logs from both units showing C6/SDIO initialization, central/peripheral role selection, encrypted GATT connection, lobby synchronization, sustained bidirectional Doom input, disconnect neutralization, and clean return to the launcher

usb_vbus_assessment.device_mode_scope: H2 TinyUSB high-speed MSC sink/device only; no VBUS source or USB host role
usb_vbus_assessment.required_next_test: measure H2 VBUS with board powered, measure direction/backfeed with board unpowered, qualify a current-limited powered host fixture, and test a controller on a direct H2 data path without a high-speed hub
usb_vbus_assessment.experimental_host_data_path_scope: operator-attested externally powered hub only; firmware reported physical_vbus_source=external and firmware_vbus_source=0

port_policy.elecrow_10_in_firmware_reuse: reuse game API, shell, storage abstractions, and platform boundaries only
port_policy.first_image: pin-independent bring-up plus board-specific display diagnostic
